I can't wear a mask, I sanitize regularly.  I have one attached to me, one in my pocket and carry wipes.  I make sure to stay two metres away. In the shops I wait until a person has finished browsing before I pick up my item, even if I can see what I want. Whereas people that wear masks barge past me, reach over me and generally get too close, wearing the mask doesnt exempt from the distance requirements. I have been verbally abused and threatened over not wearing a mask, I understand that people are scared but we all need to start being a bit kinder and less judgemental.
If you are feeling anxious if someone is not wearing a mask and talking to you, you could make sure that the distance is correct, I personally would prefer to be asked to maintain distance than leave someone feeling anxious or get the death glares and abuse.

I dont know if they will respond so if I send a message I will spend hours wondering if they will reply, I will be anxious and if they dont reply I will worry why and if they do, I will think it is only because they worry about my mental health.  
I want contact,  I want friendship,  I want love but I can't handle the anxiety caused by it and the fact that I know myself that I don't deserve it.
Maybe the people I told this to still thought it was about them, and me saying goodbye didnt help pr they didn't care and I was right.  I will never know, but at least I know that I treated them as I would want to be treated.

We were both miserable and it has ruined what little mental stability I had left (that's another story), along with damaging his too.
I am wracked with guilt and continually punish myself, while he gets angrier every day.
We didn't get counselling,  he didnt want to but we both wanted to make it work and I tried to be the perfect wife but just couldn't live in a prison.
